about: RUNS A LANDED CAR'S RECORDED PROBE — as the low-privilege account boss-probe, never root and never the checkout's owner — and writes the verdict on the car: `boss prove <car> --from-car --unattended`, the tree's CLI installed on this host from the converged image (infra/estate/install-cli-from-image.sh; backlog 9f00a805 car 1). Until car 2 of the same item (2026-09-18) this verb ran infra/forge/run-car-probe.sh, 482 lines of shell re-implementing `boss prove`'s judge, verdict and records because the forge had no boss binary; the twin and its pin are deleted and the one definition is crates/orchestrators/boss-cli/src/prove.rs. The dispatcher rule run-car-probes-on-train-arrived files one of these per car aboard an arrived train that recorded `proof_probe`/`proof_expect` at park time (`boss gate --park-probe/--park-expect`); recheck-failing-probes-hourly files one per car whose last run settled nothing (hourly since a9dafed6, 2026-09-19: the events these probes wait on are sub-daily, so a daily recheck left cars provable and unlooked-at for up to sixteen hours). The verb re-reads the car from the system of record and refuses (exit 2, nothing run) unless it is a ship-a-change car with metadata.merged=true, a recorded probe AND expect, and an open `proven` step — and exits 2 the same way, nothing run, when this host cannot make the empty token directory a probe runs beside — an environment refusal, recorded on the car under proof_environment_refusal {at, host, cause} and, when the car has no attempt or its last one said not yet, as a NOT YET proof_attempt (environment:true, exit null) so the hourly recheck retries it; a failed attempt is never overwritten by one (backlog 2e1f609e, review 2d0043ad); ONE refusal follows a run instead of preceding it — a probe that ran while the reader door refused a read it asked for, because that port's gate does not name the reader credential, has its result discarded whatever it exited and is recorded the same way, as `the probe ran without a read it asked for`, never as a failed proof (backlog e65dde24, review 991bb439 N1); a car already proven is nothing to run, exit 0. It runs the probe with `runuser -u boss-probe` (BOSS_PROBE_USER), cwd /var/lib/boss/probe-view (BOSS_PROBE_DIR) — a root-owned clone of the converged checkout the account can read and cannot write, refreshed before every runner tick — under a 60 s timeout; both names come from the drop-in infra/forge/probe-account.sh writes on this host's converge (backlog 703358ce, decided by David on design-doc bdc60b65: no sudo, no docker, no group but its own; the controls are the probe-account-controls verb). STOP, NEVER FALL BACK (decided on design-doc c98c79aa, question fallback): the drop-in also names a marker (BOSS_PROBE_VERIFIED_FILE) that the script's verify-tick writes ahead of each runner tick only when the account and its view verify by effect THEN; without it this verb runs nothing — an environment refusal before runuser, exit 2, recorded on the car as did-not-run with the cause and retried by the hourly recheck, never NOT PROVEN and never a run as david — and the host's converge is red with `probe_account: STOPPED` until a later tick repairs it. It runs under that timeout (BOSS_PROBE_TIMEOUT), with exactly the environment a recorded probe is promised — BOSS_JOBS_URL, the READ-ONLY reader identity as BOSS_SOR_USER (audit-readonly, 61085a9e), its port table as BOSS_SOR_PORTS (design 28d2bed9) and infra/forge/probe-bin first on PATH — and never this verb's own write actor; judges by the two rules `boss prove` applies (exit 0 and the expected string printed, a number as a whole token); completes `proven` with `boss prove`'s proof record and proven_by on green, or stamps `proof_attempt` on the car, leaves `proven` ready and exits so this packet's exit_code carries the verdict: 1 not proven, 3 did not run (fd 9 caught a tool this host lacks — f9304366), 75 not yet. The output leads with PROVEN / NOT YET / NOT RUN / NOT PROVEN and the car. BOSS_ACTOR is the runner's own account, handed over by ops-runner.sh; BOSS_JOBS_URL is /etc/boss/sor.env through the runner's unit. Nothing on this host is mutated by the verb itself. The bound, honestly: the probe is program text the car's builder wrote — the same builder whose branch just merged and was converged onto the cluster by this host as this same user — and what may run is exactly one recorded command, for a merged car only, as an account with no sudo, no docker and no read of david's files — which the probe-account-controls verb proves on the host rather than this sentence. The verb's own argument is a full uuid, pattern-checked here. Authorization: the routed build on backlog 28ac45ab (2026-09-08), the same per-verb process as reclaim-disk / converge / publish-github-pr — flagged for David's review as the first verb that runs builder-authored text.
